answer: Cap admissions: each epoch the network sells only twelve newcomer seats by sealed-bid auction, every winner pays the lowest winning bid, and proceeds fund graders. A farm wanting fifty heads must win fifty seats over several epochs, and each extra bid it places raises the clearing price it pays on all of them. The free-identity fable ends: like a raven hoarding shiny things the farm can grab seats, but the cost is crystal clear and public to everyone watching who keeps buying.
